status: PARTIAL — not ready to call the whole repair plan finished
jira: No Jira connector or project was available; no Jira issues were changed.

fixes.issue: Rare colours lost during palette sampling
fixes.change: Use every exact source colour when flat artwork fits its selected palette budget; record smoothing and colour-reduction changes separately. Cleanup decisions and original pixels remain reviewable.
fixes.before: A 3×3 black feature at an unlucky sampling position became skin colour, with automatic_changes=false.
fixes.after: The colour survives quantization; subsequent cleanup is recorded with actual bounds. New focused tests: old code 5 failed / 1 passed; fixed code 6 passed.

fixes.issue: Old prepared previews reused after processing changes
fixes.change: Preparation and restored-plan lookup share a code-and-knowledge revision key. Existing files are retained, but stale plans are not presented as current.
fixes.regression: Old v2 plan acceptance reproduced; rejected after the change.

fixes.issue: Small selected raster pieces silently omitted by the fill converter
fixes.change: Show real pixel bounds and physical dimensions before approval, and refuse incomplete generation before replacing files. The existing warning panel remains visible in Edit and its keyboard-accessible button zooms to the detail.
fixes.before: A selected 2×2-pixel detail was skipped by the converter's contour-area threshold.
fixes.after: A 0.5×0.5 mm case shows its true size and is blocked explicitly, not removed.
fixes.limitation: This is an honesty/safety fix, not a new generator for very small raster contours.
fixes.regression: Two new tests failed on old code. Palette-only existing test now explicitly excludes the tiny black component it previously silently omitted.

fixes.issue: Valid font geometry rejected; missing characters poorly explained
fixes.change: Recognize bent rungs and overlapping authored ribbons using source-boundary winding, preserve open counters, prefer established unambiguous rail interpretations, and name missing characters. Font paths are not rewritten and export checks are not relaxed.
fixes.regression: Bent-rung and missing-character-message tests failed before the changes. The real ampersand case now passes DST/PES checks.

native_real_engine.core_cases: All 17 word/verse cases passed at nominal font settings 4–6 mm, including the verse with 100 and 110 mm available width.
native_real_engine.blocked_cases: The full alphabet with semicolon on a reverse-sewn line fails at 4, 5 and 6 mm because the installed font substitutes a replacement glyph. Original failing layouts remain in the test.
native_real_engine.explicit_alternative: A different, explicitly authored five-line layout placing the semicolon on a forward line passes at all three sizes. The app does not change line breaks automatically.
native_real_engine.passed_case_checks: Zero short/long stitches, empty-area crossings, reported missing columns and uncut travel under existing software checks. DST/PES trim counts match. Three repeated downloads of each approved file are byte-identical.

image_real_engine.scope: Synthetic two-colour logo with transparent hole; real app generation and download routes, readback in both formats.

cold_native_generation.note: Fresh font generation still changes paths/counts. Identical cached downloads do not establish cold determinism.
